candidate.answerReason: The equation factors as \((x-\frac34)(2x-\frac54)=0\). Its roots are \(\frac34\) and \(\frac58\), so the smaller root is \(\frac58\).

methods.label: Extract the shared factor
methods.explanation:
Both terms contain \(x-\frac34\). Factoring out this shared expression turns the equation into a product equal to zero:
\[
\left(x-\frac34\right)\left[\left(x-\frac34\right)+\left(x-\frac12\right)\right]=0,
\]
so
\[
\left(x-\frac34\right)\left(2x-\frac54\right)=0.
\]
A product is zero exactly when at least one factor is zero. Thus the complete list of roots is
\[
x=\frac34\qquad\text{or}\qquad x=\frac58.
\]
Since \(\frac34=\frac68>\frac58\), the smaller root is \(\boxed{\frac58}\), choice C.
